skill.summary: Design viral product features by identifying natural sharing moments, providing standalone value, minimizing invite friction, tracking viral coefficient, and...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the "growth-virality" skill.

- Provides best practices for engineering viral loops within product features and user flows.
- Explains methods to identify authentic sharing moments and ensure shared content is valuable to new users.
- Recommends tracking the viral coefficient (K) for meaningful growth measurement.
- Outlines ways to minimize friction in invite/share flows to improve completion rates.
- Emphasizes rewarding the inviting user to boost viral sharing reliability.
- Includes a quick reference of viral loop types and examples.
- Lists common pitfalls to avoid when building viral growth mechanisms.
- Suggests product validation using AI-simulated user testing via Racoonn.
